name: vscode-browser
description: A full web browser inside VS Code with an element picker, drawing, screenshots, device emulation and Chrome extension support, built for giving AI agents context.

vscodeBrowser.homepage.markdownDescription: Page opened by the Home button. Use `vb://newtab` for the new tab page.

vscodeBrowser.searchEngine.description: Search engine used for address bar input that is not a URL.

vscodeBrowser.searchEngineUrl.markdownDescription: Search URL for the `custom` search engine. `%s` is replaced by the search terms, e.g. `https://kagi.com/search?q=%s`.

vscodeBrowser.chromium.executablePath.markdownDescription: Path to a Chromium-based browser to use instead of the downloaded Chrome for Testing. Note that branded Google Chrome does not allow loading extensions.

vscodeBrowser.chromium.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line switches passed to Chromium. Takes effect after restarting the browser engine.

vscodeBrowser.render.jpegQuality.description: JPEG quality of the page image streamed into VS Code. Higher is sharper but uses more CPU.

vscodeBrowser.tabs.maxLive.description: Maximum number of tabs per window that keep their page loaded. Older background tabs are unloaded and reload when you switch to them.

vscodeBrowser.downloads.directory.description: Folder for downloads. Defaults to your Downloads folder.

vscodeBrowser.ignoreLocalhostCertificate.description: Accept invalid (e.g. self-signed) HTTPS certificates on localhost. Takes effect after restarting the browser engine.

vscodeBrowser.openLinksFromTerminal.description: Make localhost URLs in the terminal open in the VS Code browser.

vscodeBrowser.liveReloadFiles.description: Reload tabs showing a local file when that file is saved.

vscodeBrowser.showStatusBarItem.description: Show a status bar button that opens the browser.

vscodeBrowser.debug.logCdp.description: Log every Chrome DevTools Protocol command to the output channel (trace level).

vscodeBrowser.showBookmarksBar.description: Show the bookmarks bar under the address bar (when it has bookmarks).

enumDescriptions: Reopen the tabs of browser windows that were open when VS Code closed.
Restored browser windows start with a new tab page.
vscodeBrowser.session.restore.description: What to do with open browser tabs when VS Code restarts or reloads.

vscodeBrowser.devices.custom.markdownDescription: Your own device presets for the device toolbar. Save one from the toolbar, or add entries like `{ "name": "Kiosk", "width": 1080, "height": 1920, "dpr": 1, "mobile": false, "touch": true, "userAgent": "desktop" }`.

vscodeBrowser.screenshots.directory.markdownDescription: Folder for screenshots. Relative paths are inside the workspace. Default: `.vscode-browser/screenshots` in the workspace (or the extension storage without a workspace).

vscodeBrowser.screenshots.saveFile.markdownDescription: Also save each screenshot as a file (in `#vscodeBrowser.screenshots.directory#`). Screenshots are always copied to the clipboard as an image.

vscodeBrowser.screenshots.annotationPadd.description: Space (in CSS pixels) kept around drawings when capturing the drawing area.

vscodeBrowser.inspector.copyFormat.description: Format of element details copied with the element picker.

vscodeBrowser.inspector.fields.description: Which details the element picker copies (Markdown and JSON formats).

vscodeBrowser.inspector.maxHtmlLength.description: Longest HTML snippet to copy. Longer elements are copied with their children collapsed.

vscodeBrowser.inspector.writeSelectionFi.markdownDescription: Also write the last picked element(s) to `.vscode-browser/context/selection.md` in the workspace, so AI agents can read it.

vscodeBrowser.drawing.clearOnNavigation.description: Remove drawings when the tab navigates to another page.

vscodeBrowser.devtools.enabled.markdownDescription: Open a local debugging port (random, 127.0.0.1 only) so **Open DevTools** can show Chrome DevTools. Other programs on this computer could connect to it too; turn it off if that matters. Takes effect after restarting the browser engine.

vscodeBrowser.agent.confirmNavigation.markdownDescription: Ask before an agent in VS Code chat opens a page in the browser (the `browser_navigate` tool). MCP clients ask for approval themselves.

enumDescriptions: The agent running in a terminal (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and others): its path or text is typed into the terminal, without pressing Enter.
VS Code chat, with the text or files attached.
vscodeBrowser.agent.sendTarget.markdownDescription: Where **Send to Agent** goes by default. With `terminal`, it goes to the AI agent running in a terminal (the one used last when several run; pick another in the **Saved** view). Plain shells never receive sends unless you pick them with **Browser: Choose Agent Terminal**.

vscodeBrowser.agent.command.markdownDescription: The command that **Start agent** runs in a new terminal (in the Saved view, or when you send with no agent running). For example `claude`, `codex` or `gemini`.

vscodeBrowser.agent.collectConsoleErrors.markdownDescription: Add the console errors of each page to the **Saved** list as they happen, so you can send them to your agent in one click.

vscodeBrowser.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Serve the browser tools as an MCP server on 127.0.0.1 for agents outside VS Code (for example CLI agents). Requests need a token; use **Browser: Copy MCP Server Configuration** to set up a client. Agents in VS Code chat use the built-in tools and do not need this.

vscodeBrowser.mcp.port.markdownDescription: Port of the MCP server. `0` picks a free port once and keeps it.

vscodeBrowser.bridge.enabled.markdownDescription: Let the **Inkspect browser extension** (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox) link to VS Code on `127.0.0.1` to sync bookmarks and send screenshots and element details to chat or a terminal agent. Pair a browser once: click **Pair Browser Extension** in the Browser side panel.

vscodeBrowser.bridge.port.markdownDescription: Port of the browser link. The extension tries this port and the next four.

vscodeBrowser.bridge.syncBookmarks.markdownDescription: Sync bookmarks both ways with linked browsers.

vscodeBrowser.agent.tmuxSockets.markdownDescription: tmux servers to look for agents on, by socket name (`tmux -L <name>`): agents running in their panes (for example **agentmux** threads, on `agents`) can receive sends from the Saved view and the browser. `default` is the tmux server you get without `-L`.

vscodeBrowser.hub.enabled.markdownDescription: Register the **browser helper** with your browsers (Linux): the Inkspect browser extension then links to VS Code without pairing, and can save captures into your projects and send them to agents even when VS Code is closed. Run **Browser: Remove Browser Helper** to unregister it.

vscodeBrowser.shortcuts.markdownDescription: Your browser shortcuts: an action id to its keys (for example `"mode.draw": "ctrl+alt+d"`; `[]` removes a shortcut). Edit them in the **Shortcuts** view of the Browser sidebar. VS Code Settings Sync and the paired Inkspect browser extension carry them to your other devices.

vscodeBrowser.shortcutsUpdated.markdownDescription: When the shortcuts last changed (set by the Shortcuts view; used to sync them with the Inkspect browser extension).

vscodeBrowser.record.maxSeconds.markdownDescription: Longest recording, in seconds (**Record the page** mode).

languageModelTools.name: browser_navigate
languageModelTools.displayName: Open a URL in the browser
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a URL in the browser
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Opens a URL in the active tab of the VS Code Browser (a Chromium browser inside VS Code) and waits for it to load. Use it to show or check a web page, for example a local dev server such as http://localhost:3000. Returns the final URL and page title.

url.description: The URL to open. http, https and file URLs; a missing scheme means https (http for localhost).

languageModelTools.name: browser_screenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Takes a screenshot of the page in the VS Code Browser and saves it as an image file. Captures the visible viewport by default, the whole page with mode "fullPage", or one element with a CSS selector. Returns the file path (and the image, where supported).

mode.description: What to capture when no selector is given. Default: viewport.

selector.description: CSS selector of an element to capture instead (the first match).

languageModelTools.name: browser_get_element
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns details of the first element matching a CSS selector on the page in the VS Code Browser: a unique selector, XPath, role and accessible name, size and position, key computed styles, the UI framework component and its source file when detectable, and trimmed HTML.

languageModelTools.name: browser_get_selection
languageModelTools.displayName: Get the element the user picked
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get the element the user picked
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the element(s) the user last picked with the element selector cursor of the VS Code Browser, as Markdown details. Use it when the user refers to "this element" or "the element I selected".

languageModelTools.name: browser_console_errors
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns console errors, warnings and uncaught exceptions of the page in the VS Code Browser since it was loaded, with source locations (workspace paths when they map to workspace files).

languageModelTools.name: browser_failed_requests
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns network requests of the page in the VS Code Browser that failed or returned HTTP 400 or above. Requests are recorded from the first call on (or from when the developer drawer was opened), so reload the page after the first call to see requests made while loading.

languageModelTools.name: browser_page_context
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns a summary of the page in the VS Code Browser: URL, title, viewport or emulated device, the text the user selected, recent console errors and failed requests.

languageModelTools.name: browser_get_page_text
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the visible text of the page in the VS Code Browser (document.body.innerText), with its URL and title. Long pages are truncated.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters to return. Default 20000.

scripts.build:webview: vite build --config webview/vite.config.mts --mode development && vite build --config webview/vite.shortcuts.config.mts --mode development && vite build --config webview/vite.context.config.mts --mode development
scripts.build:prod: node esbuild.mjs --production && vite build --config webview/vite.config.mts --mode production && vite build --config webview/vite.shortcuts.config.mts --mode production && vite build --config webview/vite.context.config.mts --mode production
